definitions.gloss: excuse; evasion; pretext; talking one's way out
definitions.explanation: An attempt to avoid responsibility or blame through words, excuses, or explanations that deflect the issue. Carries a negative connotation — the excuse is seen as dishonest or inadequate.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{言|い}い{逃|のが}れだ。
{言|い}い{逃|のが}れはやめて、⟦{正直|しょうじき}→正直：01562_shoujiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{話|はな}して→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Stop making excuses and speak honestly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{証拠|しょうこ}→証拠：10575_shouko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{突|つ}きつけられて→突きつける：10542_tsukitsukeru⟧、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧{言|い}い{逃|のが}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できなく→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Confronted with evidence, he could no longer talk his way out of it.

notes:
USAGE:
Always negative in connotation. The speaker views the excuse as dishonest, insufficient, or evasive. Can also be used as a verb: {言|い}い{逃|のが}れる (to talk one's way out of something).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {言|い}い{逃|のが}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to make excuses)
- {言|い}い{逃|のが}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ (to be unable to make excuses)
- ⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{言|い}い{逃|のが}れ (just an excuse)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{言|い}い{訳|わけ}→言い訳：04653_iiwake⟧: excuse — broader term, can be neutral or negative
- ⟦{弁解|べんかい}→弁解：07993_benkai⟧: justification, defense — more formal, implies defending one's actions
- {逃|に}げ{口上|こうじょう}: evasive excuse — a prepared excuse to escape responsibility
